verification_policy: Direct research with cross-source classification and acquisition review. Preserve cast-exclusive status and do not infer Ultimate Finish requirements without explicit evidence.
research_scope: Father-Son Kamehameha — Ki Blast Ultimate / unavailable for CaC.

verification_audit.method: Cross-checked the Xenoverse 2 Ultimate Attack index, dedicated Father-Son Kamehameha documentation, and broader Dragon Ball reference material. The record is kept distinct from One-Handed Kamehameha and its mk.II variant.
verification_audit.classification_finding: Current Xenoverse 2 documentation identifies Father-Son Kamehameha as a 300-Ki Ki Blast Ultimate and categorizes it as unavailable for CaC.
verification_audit.acquisition_finding: The reviewed sources identify the move as a cast-exclusive Gohan skill rather than a CaC-acquirable skill. A precise player acquisition route is therefore not asserted.
verification_audit.ultimate_finish_policy: Ultimate Finish requirement is recorded as null because the reviewed evidence does not establish an Ultimate Finish-dependent acquisition route.
verification_audit.variant_policy: Father-Son Kamehameha is kept separate from One-Handed Kamehameha, One-Handed Kamehameha mk.II, and DUAL One-Handed Kamehameha.
verification_audit.damage_policy: No fixed canonical damage value is recorded because the reviewed sources do not provide a stable database-ready value independent of character/build conditions.

records.name: Father-Son Kamehameha
records.skill_description: Gohan charges and fires a one-handed Kamehameha joined by Goku's spirit, then gives the blast an additional push before staggering.
records.mechanics_notes: Long startup and multi-hit behavior are documented. The skill is categorized as unbreakable and multi-hitting and is unavailable for CaC.
